name: Accounting
description: General Ledger Engine with double entry, multi-currency, journal templates and JSONB metadata, plus what a business that bills clients runs through it: invoices, payments, work billed as quantity times rate, recurring fees, success fees, client funds, bank reconciliation, period close and an audit trail.
